snippet.title: Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why - TRAILER
snippet.description:
Life sometimes feels like it’s going in circles.
The little girl on Earth tells herself this, forever.

Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why, our first Visual Novel will be released in early March on itch.io and Steam. 

Thanks to everyone who takes the time to play !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4426850/Little_Girl_On_Earth_Asking_Why_She_Asking_Why/
